positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
Mortar is used by data scientists and data engineers who rely on open technologies such as Pig, Python, and Luigi to work with high-volume data. 

Our goal is to help our users spend 100% of their time on problems that are unique to their business. To that end, we facilitate rapid iteration while developing, we handle production pipeline infrastructure, deploying, and monitoring, and we provide world-class open implementations of common applications such as recommendation engines.
